literal_meaning: বায়ুতে হালকা বস্তুর দ্রুত নড়াচড়ার অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: The sensation of rapid movement of thin or light objects in the wind
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাপড়ের টুকরো ফরফর করে উড়ে যাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
The piece of cloth is flapping away rapidly.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to mimic the sound and motion of light objects in the breeze.
